basic_info.description: Top floor charming 3-bedroom Edwardian home in vibrant Cole Valley. Living spaces flow beautifully together with bright living room, and two bedrooms at front of house (one as part of the double parlor and the other offers an office alcove). Huge hallway skylight & multiple tubular lighting. Freshly painted, hardwood floors buffed, new light fixtures. Multiple stained glass windows add a touch of elegance while offering privacy and warm light. Kitchen featuring a Bertazzoni stove/oven, Fisher & Paykel refrigerator, adjacent to a box beamed ceiling dining/seating room overlooking the backyard with lovely architectural and greenery vistas of neighborhood plus the 3rd bedroom are at the rear. The three versatile bedrooms offer flexible living options. Thoughtful amenities include dishwasher in separate room, washer/dryer on sun porch, plus convenient split bath. Shared storage, deck & garden. Prime location steps from La Boulangerie, Zazie, Cole Hardware, and local cafes. Golden Gate Park nearby with excellent transit access w/ N-Judah and various MUNI just steps from your door. Includes shared storage and rotational monthly parking (March, June, September, December exclusive use). Self managed small 3-unit HOA. Perfect urban village living in one of SF's most beloved neighborhood
